name: gym-ues-project
description: Sistema de Checador Gimnasio UES - React + Express + MongoDB Atlas
author: Gimnasio UES

scripts.dev:app: wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:3001/api/health && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.dist:checador: npm run build && electron-builder --win -c.productName="Gym UES Checador" -c.executableName="Gym UES Checador" -c.appId="com.ues.gym.checador" -c.artifactName="Gym UES Checador Setup ${version}.${ext}" -c.directories.output="release-checador"
scripts.lint: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check server/index.js && node --check server/db.js && node --check server/db-map.js && node --check server/scope.js && node --check server/catalogos.js && node --check server/middleware.js && node --check server/cache.js && node --check server/keygen.js && node --check server/almacen.js && node --check server/migrar-a-mongo.js && node --check server/migrar-archivos.js && node --check server/limpiar-archivos.js && node --check server/models/index.js && node --check server/models/serializador.js && node --check server/models/alumno.model.js && node --check server/models/asistencia.model.js && node --check server/models/usuario.model.js && node --check server/models/ajuste.model.js && node --check server/routes/auth.routes.js && node --check server/routes/attendance.routes.js && node --check server/routes/students.routes.js && node --check server/routes/panel.routes.js && node --check server/routes/settings.routes.js && node --check server/routes/public.routes.js && node --check server/routes/archivos.routes.js && node --check server/routes/uploads.routes.js && node --check server/routes/users.routes.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('shared/catalogos.json','utf8')); console.log('shared/catalogos.json OK')" && echo "Sintaxis OK"
scripts.test: npm run lint:identificadores && npm run test:render
